reviews.author: little hernandez
reviews.text: Please don’t go to this place It’s 7:26 am He opens at 7:30 I had just a simple question and instead of greeting and saying good morning give me a few min we not quiet open He proceeded to close his door in my face Just a simple act of kindness was to much for him.

reviews.author: A Demonz
reviews.text: Had an awful morning… Tire went flat, but Adam's Tire & Auto Repair saved the day! Replaced my tire quickly and got me back on the road in no time! I’m so thankful for small towns and their willingness to jump in and help. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Frank Crisafulli
reviews.text: Just awesome service every time. Adam and his crew are folks you can trust and they do great work. Don’t hesitate to take your vehicles here!

reviews.author: dhippstarr
reviews.text: Adam always goes over and above for his customers and clients and friends, he really treats people right and I've watched him treat all the female staff of our Veterinary Hospital fairly for many years now I do my own work unless I happen to be away from my shop in need a little emergency fixer upper and as I have always known him to do he charged a fair price did it quick and did it right. Adam is a great resource in Burgaw for auto and tire needs don't hesitate you can trust them

reviews.author: Amber Williams
reviews.text: Had a nail in my tire. Took my car there while I was at work without an appointment and they had it fixed within an hour! Awesome place!

reviews.author: Russell Mason
reviews.text: Been there many times and I have always been happy with the service. Friendly and helpful and always honest. I will be back
